name: set_party_members

stack.evidence: func_001D7300 consumes three character IDs in order and passes them to func_0013C708, which writes the three optional party-roster slots at D_003010F8 + 0x48F through +0x491

notes: func_0013C708 accepts character IDs 0 through 9 and writes 0xFF for any other value, including the corpus's -1 empty-slot sentinel. The 21 JP calls configure combinations of character IDs 1, 2, 5, and 9 or clear all three optional slots; the adjacent command 281 reads these roster slots and command 366 counts their valid members.
